extraction_notes: Figures 2, 6 and 7 contain plotted performance data. Values explicitly printed in text were copied with qualifier '='. Other plotted values were read approximately with qualifier '~'. Continuous stability traces in Fig. 7A are summarized as the reported 120 h stable performance rather than every dense time-series point. Literature examples in the Introduction were not extracted.
